Definition: of Chaldee origin (H1247 and H8526); son of Tolmai; Bar-tholomæus, a Christian apostle:--Bartholomeus.
BiblicalUsage: Bartholomew, the son of Tolmai, is named among the twelve apostles in every list. He is named again among those who waited in the upper room after the ascension.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Bartholomew's quiet name teaches us that faithfulness is not always loud, because he is named in every list of the twelve and says nothing in the record, yet he was chosen and he stayed.
